plan: - Electrical: Long-range flight controller (e.g., Pixhawk/ArduPilot), high-capacity Li-ion battery, powerful BLDC motor, ESC, long-range radio link (e.g., Crossfire/ELRS), GPS, airspeed sensor.

nodes.name: Main Flight Controller
nodes.description: Primary flight control unit based on STM32H753, includes integrated IMU (ICM-20689) and barometer (MS5611) for stable flight and navigation.

nodes.name: Main Propulsion Motor
nodes.description: Brushless DC motor for forward propulsion.

nodes.name: Motor Electronic Speed Controller
nodes.description: Electronic Speed Controller for the main brushless motor, handling high current for propulsion.

nodes.name: Long Range Radio Link (TX/RX)
nodes.description: Encrypted low-latency digital control and video link transceiver.

nodes.name: GPS Module
nodes.description: Provides global positioning data for navigation.

nodes.name: Airspeed Sensor
nodes.description: Measures drone's speed through the air for improved fixed-wing flight control.

nodes.name: Power Management Module
nodes.description: Power distribution board and voltage/current sensor for the flight controller and ESCs.

nodes.name: Main Wing
nodes.description: Primary lift surface for long-range flight. Typically foam core with composite skin.

nodes.name: Fuselage Body
nodes.description: Main body of the UAV, houses electronics and battery.

nodes.name: Horizontal Stabilizer
nodes.description: Provides pitch stability for the UAV.

nodes.name: Vertical Stabilizer
nodes.description: Provides yaw stability for the UAV.

nodes.name: Main Propeller
nodes.description: Propeller for main propulsion motor.

nodes.name: Left Aileron Servo
nodes.description: Controls the left aileron for roll control.

nodes.name: Right Aileron Servo
nodes.description: Controls the right aileron for roll control.

nodes.name: Elevator Servo
nodes.description: Controls the elevator for pitch control.

nodes.name: Rudder Servo
nodes.description: Controls the rudder for yaw control.

nodes.name: Left Aileron Control Horn
nodes.description: Connects servo pushrod to left aileron.

nodes.name: Right Aileron Control Horn
nodes.description: Connects servo pushrod to right aileron.

nodes.name: Elevator Control Horn
nodes.description: Connects servo pushrod to elevator.

nodes.name: Rudder Control Horn
nodes.description: Connects servo pushrod to rudder.

nodes.name: Left Aileron Pushrod
nodes.description: Transfers motion from servo to left aileron.

nodes.name: Right Aileron Pushrod
nodes.description: Transfers motion from servo to right aileron.

nodes.name: Elevator Pushrod
nodes.description: Transfers motion from servo to elevator.

nodes.name: Rudder Pushrod
nodes.description: Transfers motion from servo to rudder.

nodes.name: Main Motor Mount
nodes.description: Mounts the main propulsion motor to the fuselage firewall.

nodes.name: Flight Controller Mount
nodes.description: Securely holds the flight controller inside the fuselage, reducing vibration.

nodes.name: Flight Battery Tray
nodes.description: Secures the high-capacity Li-ion battery within the fuselage.

nodes.name: ESC Mount
nodes.description: Provides a secure and ventilated mounting point for the ESC.

nodes.name: Long Range RX Mount
nodes.description: Mounts the long-range radio receiver securely inside the fuselage.

nodes.name: GPS Module Mount
nodes.description: Positions the GPS module for optimal signal reception, often externally.

nodes.name: Airspeed Sensor Mount
nodes.description: Mounts the pitot tube for the airspeed sensor at the front of the wing or fuselage.

nodes.name: Power Management Module Mount
nodes.description: Secures the power management module within the fuselage.

nodes.name: Wing Attachment Mechanism
nodes.description: Hardware for securing the main wing to the fuselage, often bolts and nuts.

nodes.name: Fuselage Hatch Cover
nodes.description: Provides access to internal electronics and battery compartment.

nodes.name: Front Landing Skid
nodes.description: Protects the front fuselage during belly landings.

nodes.name: Rear Landing Skid
nodes.description: Protects the rear fuselage/tail during belly landings.

nodes.description: General purpose screws for mounting various components.

subSteps.title: 3D print all custom mounts and structural components
Prepare fuselage for mounting points, including drilling pilot holes for internal components and stabilizers
Cut and prepare any necessary control linkages and control horns to length
Test fit 3D printed mounts with their corresponding electrical components
Solder motor wires to the ESC, ensuring correct rotation direction or configurability
Connect the main flight battery to the power management module
Wire the power management module to the ESC for propulsion power
Connect flight controller to power management module for power, current, and voltage sensing
Wire all peripheral modules (GPS, airspeed, long-range RX) to the flight controller and power management module
Connect the ESC signal wire from the flight controller's PWM output
Connect the servos to the appropriate PWM outputs on the flight controller
Initial power-up and verify all modules receive correct voltage from Power Management Module
Flash flight controller firmware and perform initial configuration
Verify flight controller recognizes all connected sensors (GPS, Airspeed, Current/Voltage sensors)
Calibrate ESC and verify motor functionality and direction
Calibrate and test servo movement for ailerons, elevator, and rudder
Configure and test long-range radio link (TX/RX) with the flight controller
Mount the Main Propulsion Motor onto its 3D printed mount, then secure to the Fuselage Body
Install all internal electrical components onto their respective 3D printed mounts and secure them within the Fuselage Body
Mount the Horizontal and Vertical Stabilizers to the Fuselage Body
Install servos and control horns into the Main Wing, Horizontal, and Vertical Stabilizers
Connect all pushrods between servos and control horns, ensuring free movement
Attach the Main Wing to the Fuselage Body using the wing attachment mechanism
Install the propeller onto the main motor shaft
Secure the Fuselage Hatch Cover and attach landing skids
